name: Progressive Sparse Voxel Optimization
definition: A reconstruction strategy that starts with a dense, coarse scene grid (full, shallow SVO) and gradually sparsifies by merging nodes or adds detail via subdivision, optimizing fields for a fixed SVO structure before changing the structure.
summary: Progressive Sparse Voxel Optimization is a coarse-to-fine reconstruction strategy that dynamically prunes free space and subdivides occupied regions in a Sparse Voxel Octree to balance memory efficiency and geometric detail.
